title: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 35: What to expect
summary: The House prosecution panel on Wednesday will continue its presentation of witnesses from banks and financial firms to testify on Article 2 of the impeachment case against Vice President Sara…

blocks.text: The House prosecution panel on Wednesday will continue its presentation of witnesses from banks and financial firms to testify on Article 2 of the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte, alleging her unexplained wealth.
Based on a briefer from the Senate impeachment court, the following bank and insurance officials are lined up as witnesses for today’s trial:

Asia United Bank (AUB)* Arcy James Gonzales - Branch Manager of Davao Toril Branch* Edeli Umayam - Branch Manager of Davao Tagum Branch* Jerilee Mae Sanidad - Branch Manager of Ortigas Ave. Greenhills Branch
Philippine Savings Bank (PSB)* Irene Joy Ishida - Head of Branch Operations Department
Metropolitan Bank & Trust Company (Metrobank)* Atty. Niña Feren Aguilar - Head of Anti-Money Laundering Division
Security Bank Corporation* Leslie Cham - Branch Banking Group Head
Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI)* Marwin Galvez - Division Head for Central Manila Branches
Philippine National Bank (PNB)* Julius Parian - Branch Manager of Davao San Pedro CM Recto Branch

BDO Unibank Inc. (BDO)* Mario Cirilo De Mesa, Jr. - Senior AVP Branch Banking Group, Branch Regulatory Support* Merian Manoguid - VP for Consumer Banking Group* Patricia Lei Alvarillo - Senior VP for Trust and Investments Group
FWD Life Insurance Corporation* Atty. Juan Sotero Roman - Chief Legal and Compliance Officer
During Tuesday’s trial, the prosecution, through Atty. James Bryan Alih, began presenting bank officials to testify on Article 2 of the Articles of Impeachment.
First in the group to be called to the witness stand was Landbank representative Eunice Sumatra from Davao Branch, followed by Landbank representative Raquel Dela Cerna of Davao R. Magsaysay Branch.

Sumatra testified that the payroll account of the Vice President is an active account in their branch, while dela Cerna told the Senate impeachment court that Carpio had an ending balance of worth at least P1.3 million in his bank account in LandBank Davao Magsaysay Branch as of end of 2025. —KG, GMA News
